description: List the tables, views, and materialized views this connection can read, with their descriptions. Call this first when you need to know what data exists — do not guess table names. Pass `pattern` to narrow by a word appearing anywhere in the table name or its description; call it again with a different word to try a synonym. For anything more specific — searching column names, types, or comments — query information_schema and pg_catalog directly with the query tool, they are ordinary tables.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum tables to return (default 100, max 500).

pattern.description: Optional. Case-insensitive substring matched anywhere in the table name, the qualified schema.table name, or the table description. Omit to list everything.

schema.description: Optional. Restrict to one schema, e.g. "analytics".

name: list_tables
